data.name: Brana
data.gender_notes: Brana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Brana was a goddess of brightness and illumination. In Christianity, Brana is a name for a shining, radiant girl, reminding us of the inner light and grace that resides in every child of God. The name Brana carries the meaning “Bright, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Brana usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope, light, and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Brana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, shining one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brana total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: בראנה
in_hebrew.meaning: בראנה היא שם שפירושו בורא או נברא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בראנה הוא שם עברי שפירושו בורא או נברא. הוא נגזר מהמילה העברית 'ברא' שפירושו ליצור או לברוא. השם בראנה משמש לעתים קרובות ככינוי לאלוהים כבורא העולם. השם מופיע גם בכתבי הקודש העבריים ומשמש ככינוי לאלוהים כבורא האדם.

in_greek.name: Μπράνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπράνα είναι ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει δημιουργός ή γεννημένος. Προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'μπράνω' που σημαίνει να δημιουργώ ή να γεννώ. Το όνομα Μπράνα χρησιμοποιείται συχνά ως προσωνυμία για τον Θεό ως δημιουργό του κόσμου. Το όνομα εμφανίζεται επίσης στα κείμενα της Καινής Διαθήκης και χρησιμοποιείται ως προσωνυμία για τον Θεό ως δημιουργό του ανθρώπου.

in_latin.name: Brana
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Brana is a Latin name that means creator or born. It is derived from the Latin word 'branare' which means to create or to bear. The name Brana is often used as a cognomen for God as the creator of the world. The name appears also in the early Christian literature and is used as a cognomen for God as the creator of man.

in_english.name: Brana
in_english.meaning: Brana means creator or born in Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Brana is a Christian name that means creator or born. It is derived from the Hebrew root 'bara' which means to create or to bear. The name Brana appears in the biblical context as a cognomen for God as the creator of the world. Historically, the name Brana has been used in the early Christian church as a symbol of spiritual birth and creation. The name is associated with personality traits such as creativity, leadership, and divine inspiration.

data.cultural_impact: Brana was a Greek goddess, one of the Heliades (goddesses of the sun). Her name is often associated with brightness, illumination, and clarity. In the Christian tradition, the name Brana may bring to mind this sense of brightness and radiance, as it is a reminder of the inner light that shines within every person.
data.spiritual_significance: Brana is also a Hebrew name that means "exalted one." In a spiritual sense, the name Brana can be a reminder of our connection to God and the inherent worth and dignity we possess as children of God. It can serve as a reminder to keep our hearts and minds illuminated by the light of God's love and presence, and to radiate that light out into the world. Additionally, Brana is a reflection of the radiance and beauty that comes from a deep connection with God, allowing us to shine brightly and to be a beacon of hope and light for others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Brana: Derived from the Hebrew word "bracha," meaning blessing, Brana symbolizes the recipient of God's abundant grace and protection. In Christian tradition, it also evokes the image of a strong, steadfast vessel, carrying the faith through life's stormy seas.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Brana continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.
